text:
adrien: alert from customers in eu-north1: lots of GPU attaches failing with 'scratch badblocks' and 'io timeout'. anyone awake? :frowning:
ops-bot: ALERT: eu-north1 scratch_badblocks_count increased from 2 -> 68 in 4m. nvme_io_wait > 200ms. attach_fail_rate 18%.
cam: i'm looking. `dmesg` on a few hosts shows repeated blk_read errors and nvme media failures flagged. seems localized to a subpool of instances launched last month.
neil: could be firmware cohort difference; we got a different nvme firmware in that batch. also janitor deep-verify kicked off earlier and is doing costly reads.
zara: ops note: we manually disabled badblock quarantining previously to debug false positives, so the system is still trying to read through bad sectors rather than fencing them. that increases IO.
adrien: immediate plan: 1) pause deep-verify on affected nodes 2) enable badblock quarantine to avoid repeated reads 3) gate attaches to unaffected nodes. can we do that quickly?
cam: yes. mitigation commands (control plane):
```
# pause deep-verify for nodepool
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --patch '{"data":{"deepVerify":"false","concurrency":"1"}}'
# re-enable badblock fencing
kubectl -n infra patch configmap nvme-health --patch '{"data":{"quarantineBadblocks":"true"}}'
# attach admission prefer healthy nodes
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"expr":"nvme_quarantined_blocks==0"}'
```

ops-bot: CHANGE: janitor deepVerify toggled false by cam at 4372110020. auto-rollback at 4372110620 if attach_error_rate increases.
neil: rolling the quarantine flag now. This should reduce the repeated read/retry storms. Expect attach queue to drop in ~30-60s.
zara: adding a temporary k8s taint on affected node labels 'nvme-unstable=true' so scheduler avoids them. will cordon+drain for follow-up remediation.
adrian: good. add runbook step to capture firmware versions for the cohort and map to badblock incidence. we should notify hardware vendor.
cam: can also enable soft-reserve of 2 scratch slots per node for critical attaches so we don't exhaust nodes doing retries. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"name":"scratch-soft-reserve","expr":"free_scratch_slots - soft_reserve >= 1","params":{"soft_reserve":"2"}}'
```

ops-bot: NOTE: attach queue depth in eu-north1 decreased from 210 -> 36 at 4372110045. attach success rate improved to 94%.
neil: next steps: schedule firmware audit, create remediation to reprovision affected instances with stable firmware, and add a permanent alert for badblock spike. also revert deepVerify=false only after quarantine+reprovision.
zara: i'll own the reprovision ticket and vendor outreach. adrien, can you file the postmortem with timeline and detection gaps?
adrian: filing now. postmortem owner infra/storage. also we'll add an automated pre-scale check that enforces nvme_quarantine policy and prevents scrub windows during heavy attach events.
cam: one more thing: add metric `nvme_firmware_cohort` to correlate future events.
adrian: agreed. thanks team. keep this thread for remediation updates. :thumbsup:
